page.overview:
Who is Court Poet?

The was a who formerly served the . Due to his knowledge on ancient civilizations, he accompanied her on surveys of ancient ruins.

Despite knowing it was doomed, the fell in love with . However, was supposedly in love with her knight, . As was neither nobility nor royalty, the was jealous of him.

When the struck, the fled to . On the way, he witnessed sacrifice himself at to protect . Once explained what happened to him, the decided to seek out the of the hero who defeated in the past to be passed down to upon his return. His desire was that they would assist when the time came for him to save .

After the , the believed so much that would return that he wrote a song, entitled the "". During this time, he took on as a student in order to pass down the , hoping that he would one day be able to share them with .
